ravi: quick heads-up — seeing a 1.8x latency regression on nightly for fused-RoPE + FlashAttn when seq_len > 2048 and batch >= 4. root ts 1913456789
ashley: ouch. which kernel did the selector choose? any selector logs?
ravi: selector initially picked flash_attn_v2_fused_rope_fp16 (expected), but we see a fallback to flash_attn_paged_slow around token boundary ~1024. attaching profiler snippets below.
chen: can you paste the bench numbers?
ravi: ```
# bench command
./tools/bench_attention --model=llama-13b --attn=fused_rope_flash --seq=4096 --batch=4 --dtype=fp16
# baseline (fast kernel)
throughput: 3200 tokens/s
p99 token latency: 4.2ms
# observed regression (fallback path)
throughput: 1800 tokens/s
p99 token latency: 7.6ms
```
noah: nvprof + nvtx shows a big memcpy spike and L2 miss surge exactly when KV cache increments a page — looks like KV allocation/alignment thrash
ravi: yes, memcpy correlates with KV page crossing at ~1MB boundary. suspect interaction between paged attention path and ALiBi slope math + rotary scaling. disabling ALiBi reverts to baseline.
ashley: interesting. so ALiBi + fusedRoPE triggers something that causes kernel selector to prefer slow path? try repro flags: --kv-page-size=256k and --disable-alibi
ravi: tried both: --kv-page-size=256k reduces the memcpy spike but still ~1.2x slower than baseline. --disable-alibi restores baseline throughput. implies ALiBi is necessary condition, KV paging exacerbates it.
chen: hypothesis: numeric path order. If ALiBi slope multiplication happens before rotary scale cast, tiny fp16 rounding makes kernel selector think rotary dims diverged -> selector flips to conservative kernel (we have a guard in the fast kernel selection).
noah: check kernel_selector thresholds — if rotary_scale_divergence > 1e-3 we pick safe kernel. fp16 rounding could easily push that. also paging changes alignment so memcopy timing reveals stalls.
ravi: quick patch idea: clamp/quantize rotary scale to fp16-friendly values before the selector decision, and add a selector override when KV_page_count > 4 to prefer paged_flash instead of the slow generic path.
ashley: can we get a tiny repro harness for CI? minimal script + deterministic model config would help.
ravi: gist (private) posted with a repro harness and nvprof command: ```nvprof --profile-from-start off --events l2_read_transactions,dram_util ./run_repro.sh```
dev-bot: perf-bench CI triggered for thread 1913456789 (nightly)
chen: proposed plan: 1) add unit test for numeric ordering + selector tolerance; 2) implement clamp to fp16-range in selector; 3) experiment with default KV page size and add paged_flash preference when page_count>threshold; 4) run A/B on canary pool.
noah: also add a kernel-mapping regression test to ensure fused_rope+alibi picks flash_attn_v2 when conditions met.
ravi: will open PR with selector tolerance + tests. tagging @eng-runtime for selector logic review.
ashley: assigning to ravi & chen. I'll watch the console traces tonight :eyes: — please post nvprof snapshots in this thread when available.
ravi: will update with artifacts (nvprof logs, perf counters, kernel selector traces). thanks everyone.
